text.text: Witness the entire process of our products from parts to finished products
Learn how LBH Appliances manages the entire production process of hair dryers and completes your order in batches, on time and on budget.

The driver motherboard of a hair dryer product is an independent core component, which determines various functional parameters of the product, temperature in different modes, operating voltage, and other key data. LBH Electric independently designs, manufactures and tests hair dryer drivers to ensure that hair dryer products have consistently excellent quality and performance.

The manufacturing process of the air appliance driver is extremely rigorous, and our workers must accurately install and connect all components according to the design; once completed, we perform functional testing to ensure that the hair dryer driver can work properly.
The Entire Process of Motor Manufacturing
LBH Electric has an independent high-speed motor R&D and production department, and has mastered the "high-precision rotor design" in the core process of motor production.

LBH Electric's independent R&D and production department controls everything from "high-precision rotor design", "stator winding manufacturing and thermal management", "bearing system design and installation" to motor

The entire production process of "dynamic balancing and vibration control" solves core problems such as material strength, heat dissipation efficiency, support stability and vibration suppression of high-speed motors, ensuring key technical points for efficient and reliable operation of the motor.
Based on an in-depth analysis of manufacturing flexibility, LBH established a cooperative relationship with a leading mold design agency to jointly create
Hair dryer shell; carefully designed mold ensures the efficiency and safety of the molding process.
LBH uses state-of-the-art CNC machine tools and waterjet cutting machines to produce high-precision molds with an accuracy of within 0.01 mm to create perfectly formed shells.

We purchase plastic pellets from Thailand to ensure the best raw materials at the best prices; LBH Electric uses world-class YIZUMI injection molding machines to make the injection molding process reliable and precise.

After the driver, motor and casing are ready, all parts are sent to the assembly workshop for assembly. LBH appliances follow a standardized assembly process and provide a bill of materials for each model, which details the correct assembly methods and standards for the hair dryer.
All workers must complete the assembly work strictly in accordance with the bill of materials!
The assembled products should undergo a 40-minute aging test at a voltage of 110V to 220V. Only after passing the test can they be sent to the packaging line for packing.
Address: Room 1006, Building 3, Guangyi Intelligent Equipment Park, No. 9 Xingnan Road, Nanqu Community, Ronggui Subdistrict, Shunde District, Foshan City, Guangdong Province
